rule: All 9 expected columns present
Transaction ID is not null or blank
Date is not null or blank
Customer ID is not null or blank
Gender is not null or blank
Age is not null or blank
Product Category is not null or blank
Quantity is not null or blank
Price per Unit is not null or blank
Total Amount is not null or blank
Transaction ID is unique (grain = 1 row per transaction)
No fully duplicated rows
Customer ID repeats across transactions (informational)
note: 0 repeats means each customer appears once, so repeat-purchase KPIs cannot be built from this extract

rule: Transaction ID is a positive integer
Date parses as %d-%m-%Y (dd-mm-yyyy)
Date is not in the future
Customer ID matches CUST + digits
Gender is Male or Female
Age is a whole number 18-100
Product Category is in the approved list
Quantity is a whole number > 0
Price per Unit > 0
Total Amount >= 0
Total Amount = Quantity x Price per Unit
Price points per category (informational: price list looks tiered, not one price)
Transaction IDs are contiguous (no missing IDs)
Text columns have no leading/trailing spaces or case drift
Latest month is a complete period (rows >= 50% of typical month)
note: observed: 2030-10: 1 rows vs typical 78 | a partial month distorts MoM growth, so the KPI dictionary excludes it

rule: Newest transaction is <= 1 day old
note: observed: newest=2024-01-01, as-of=2026-10-15, lag=1018 days | this file is a historical snapshot, so FAIL is expected; the check proves the monitor would catch a stalled feed

rule: Data covers >= 12 months (needed for seasonality / MoM)
